dish: Sawanoi sake — free brewery tour, then ten sakes by the cup at the riverside Sawanoi-en tasting room
n: Ozawa Shuzo — Sawanoi Sake Brewery, Ōme (小澤酒造 澤乃井)
address: Sawai, Ōme, Tokyo (a few steps from JR Sawai Station, on the Tama River)
w: Tokyo's oldest brewery, founded 1702 in the Okutama hills: free tours of kura buildings over 300 years old, then a tunnel to the riverside Sawanoi-en garden to taste ten sakes by the cup — plus a sake shop and tofu restaurants.
sts: Tokyo Cheapo + Tokyo Weekender (tours bookable online, current)
